title: Code and data for Residual-based stopping rules for equilibrium-constrained optimization

authors.affiliation: School of Artificial Intelligence, Hubei University
School of Economics and Management, Wuhan University

description: Code, generated CSV/JSON data, validation scripts, and figure assets for Residual-based stopping rules for equilibrium-constrained optimization. The archive includes independent face-enumeration checks, sparse positive definite affine variational inequalities with up to 5000 lower variables, transportation-derived elastic-demand tests, and supplementary comparisons. Numerical data and executable research files are frozen from the JAMC v8 scientific version; this AMC release changes the manuscript presentation and archive documentation, not the measured results. Cached TNTP inputs retain their source attribution and academic-research terms.

National Social Science Fund of China
